ar.title: الباتية بالكريمة

steps.n1: نحضر صينية مدهونة ونضع نصف كمية الجلاش، ثم نضع الكريمة، وفوقها نصف الكمية الباقية من الجلاش، وفوقها ملعقة السمن، وتقطع.
steps.n2: تدخل فرن متوسط الحرارة حتى يصبح لونها ذهبيا.
steps.n3: تسقى باللبن البارد أو المرق البارد وتترك حتى تتشرب السائل، ثم تغطى ويطفأ الفرن.

en.title: Phyllo Pie with Custard Cream

steps.n1: Prepare a greased baking dish and layer half of the phyllo dough, then add the cream, followed by the remaining half of the phyllo dough, and top with the ghee, then cut into pieces.
steps.n2: Bake in a medium-heat oven until golden brown.
steps.n3: Pour the cold milk or cold broth over it and let it sit until the liquid is fully absorbed, then cover it and turn off the oven.

legacySteps: Prepare a greased baking dish and layer half of the phyllo dough, then add the cream, followed by the remaining half of the phyllo dough, and top with the ghee, then cut into pieces.
Bake in a medium-heat oven until golden brown.
Pour the cold milk or cold broth over it and let it sit until the liquid is fully absorbed, then cover it and turn off the oven.
